Synthetic RSS fixtures for `--dry-run` and tests. All headlines are fictional and the feeds are generated,
not copied from any publisher. `NOW` is the fixed clock dry runs use (so the 48-hour rules stay stable).
Each file is named after its source slug in `sources.yaml` (`Placeholder AI` -> `placeholder-ai.xml`).
Planted cases: tracking params on links, items without images, items older than 48 h, and near-duplicate
titles across and within feeds.
